topic: Damp Furrows sprinkler and field mouse synergy
currentUserGoal: Add one more meaningful gameplay slice by making Tiny Sprinkler and Field Mouse interact as the ecosystem's first visible production-chain synergy.
workCompleted: Added Damp Furrows: when Tiny Sprinkler and Field Mouse are both installed, each completed mouse cycle can spend 0.3 Moisture to produce 0.45 bonus Growth and 0.22 Care.
Kept the Field Mouse's ordinary Seed trip independent, so missing Moisture or full output buffers only pause the synergy bonus.
Added shared link and flowing-state helpers to the deterministic ecosystem model and exposed those states through the semantic debug snapshot.
Added player-facing Damp Furrows explanations to the Living Ledger, helper modes, Field Mouse Memory, and automation status copy.
Added a first-link presentation with a water bead traveling from the sprinkler to the mouse, an aqua impact, and a dedicated DAMP FURROWS LINKED announcement.
Separated helper-link announcements from ordinary helper-arrival announcements and positioned their lanes so DAMP FURROWS LINKED, MOISTURE + CARE, and CARE ONLINE do not overlap.
Added deterministic tests for successful paired production and for dry synergy conditions preserving normal mouse production.
Restored the browser playtest to a clean active Run 1 after live verification.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 175 Vitest tests across 21 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The focused EcosystemSystem suite passed all 37 tests before the final full project check.
Live browser QA installed the first Tiny Sprinkler and Field Mouse pair and confirmed Damp Furrows consumed Moisture while adding Growth and Care production.
The semantic snapshot reported dampFurrowsLinked and dampFurrowsFlowing accurately, and the browser console had no warnings or errors.
Final visual QA confirmed the water-link milestone and helper feedback use separate readable lanes without overlap.
The final browser state is clean Run 1 with 100 HP, zero Run Touches, zero Grass Touches, a 1x1 field, and no console warnings or errors.
git diff --check passed apart from the repository's existing Windows LF-to-CRLF notices.

gitStatus.expectedAfterCommit: Damp Furrows checkpoint committed locally; master is eight commits ahead of origin/master and has not been pushed.

knownIssues: The selected in-app browser exposes no viewport override capability, so exact 390x844 live verification was unavailable for this slice.
The Damp Furrows production values are an initial playable balance and still need hands-on natural-progression tuning.

Chicken Patrol and later helper chapters remain functional scaffolding rather than guided animated chapters.

Tune Damp Furrows Moisture cost and Growth/Care output against real Run 2 and early-midgame pacing.
